Long Stardew sessions make time disappear… but your body still lives in the real world. 💧🧘‍♂️

[b]Stardew Valley Health Reminder[/b] is a tiny quality-of-life mod that sends a gentle reminder every X [b]real-life minutes[/b] so you can stretch, drink water, rest your eyes, or simply take a break.

Perfect for marathon farming sessions, streaming, or anyone who wants to enjoy the game without forgetting self-care. 🌾💛

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[size=4][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*] Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].
[*] Download this mod and extract it.
[*] Place the folder [b]StardewValleyHealthReminder[/b] into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code] directory.
[*] Launch Stardew Valley using the SMAPI launcher.
[/list]

After the first launch, the mod will create a file called [b]config.json[/b] inside:

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/StardewValleyHealthReminder/[/code]

This file controls how often and how the reminders show.



[size=4][b]🛠️ Configuration (config.json)[/b][/size]

Open [b]config.json[/b] with any text editor (Notepad, Notepad++, VS Code, etc.).

Default example:

[code]
{
"EnableMod": true,
"ReminderIntervalMinutes": 60,
"ReminderMessageOverride": "",
"UsePopupDialogue": false
}
[/code]

Below is what each option does:

[b]• EnableMod[/b]
[i]Type:[/i] true / false
Master on/off switch for the mod.
[code]true[/code] → the mod runs and shows reminders.
[code]false[/code] → the mod is completely disabled.

---

[b]• ReminderIntervalMinutes[/b]
[i]Type:[/i] integer (number of minutes)
How often to show the reminder, in [b]real-world minutes[/b].

Examples:
[code]
15 → reminder every 15 minutes
30 → reminder every 30 minutes
60 → reminder every 1 real-life hour (default)
120 → reminder every 2 hours
[/code]

The timer only counts while a save file is loaded.

---

[b]• ReminderMessageOverride[/b]
[i]Type:[/i] string (text)

Optional custom reminder text. If this is left empty (`""`), the mod uses the translated message from the [b]i18n[/b] folder.

Example:
[code]
"ReminderMessageOverride": "Time to stretch and drink some water!"
[/code]

---

[b]• UsePopupDialogue[/b]
[i]Type:[/i] true / false

Controls how the reminder appears:

[code]false[/code] → small HUD toast in the top-left (subtle).
[code]true[/code] → large dialogue popup in the center of the screen (hard to miss).

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[size=4][b]🌐 Translations (i18n)[/b][/size]

This mod supports SMAPI’s built-in translation system.

The folder structure looks like this:

[code]
StardewValleyHealthReminder/
├─ manifest.json
├─ Stardew Valley Health Reminder.dll
└─ i18n/
├─ default.json
├─ en.json
└─ <your-language>.json
[/code]

The game automatically loads the file that matches your language.
If your language isn’t available yet, you can create a new `<language>.json` file using the same keys as [b]default.json[/b].

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[size=4][b]💖 Why use this mod?[/b][/size]

We all know how easy it is to say “just one more day” in Stardew and suddenly it’s 3 AM.
This mod is a small nudge that helps you:

[list]
[*] Stay hydrated
[*] Stretch and move around
[*] Rest your eyes
[*] Avoid burnout during long play sessions
[/list]

It doesn’t judge, it just reminds. You decide what to do with the time. 😊

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[size=4][b]✅ Tips[/b][/size]

[list]
[*] For a gentle reminder every hour, set:
[code]"ReminderIntervalMinutes": 60[/code][*] For short focused sessions, try:
[code]"ReminderIntervalMinutes": 25[/code](Perfect for “Pomodoro”-style play.)[*] Streamers can set a custom message like:
